title: iRacing Formula Vee Okayama International Full Circuit - Track Guide & Tips - Rookie Fixed Setup

corners.spoken_as: the cone on the right hand side
corners.line: Turn-in to right, apex at muddy patch, lift off, exit wide left

corners.label: T1
corners.exit: downshift to third gear at Apex, go 100% gas

corners.label: T2
corners.line: turn in at end of grass, over mud patch
corners.exit: get back on gas very early, exit wide, up to fourth gear, straighten car out through kink

corners.label: T4
corners.line: trail braking, turn in late, exit wide

corners.braking: braking marker halfway between 50 and Marshall's Hut, brake up to 80%
corners.line: turn-in at white line, lift to 5%, build back up

corners.label: T7
corners.braking: braking marker halfway between 50 and Marshall's Hut, brake up to 80%
corners.line: turn-in at white line, lift to 9%

corners.exit: get back on gas early exit

general_tips: Watch yourself getting into the hairpin at turn five
look for 25M board on right, muddy patch on left
Get this corner right for the big straight afterwards.
trail braking, lift through corners, build back up on exit
barest touch on brake to balance front wheels
